entities.summary: Alaín Roca is a former volleyball player from Cuba. A two-time Olympian, he competed in the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta and the 2000 Summer Olympics in Sydney with the Cuban men's national volleyball team. Alain Roca was a athletes & competitors from Havana (b. 1976-09-07, Havana). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
